answer: Tie each agent to one identity vertex in a public work graph, with a refundable bond per vertex. Each verified completed job adds a weighted edge from client to builder, and voting or bounty weight grows only from that history. A newcomer starts on the ledge with zero weight, however many accounts it spawns, because bonds and history never transfer between vertices. Climbing the ridge to influence means paying a bond and doing real, checkable work per identity, so a sybil flood costs linearly in bonds plus labor while honest weight compounds from one history.
